classic-small-ok4u-30.description: Low inflation is driving high share prices for this long-established pharmaceutical company.

classic-small-ok4u-40.description: A booming market is pushing up the share price of this long-established pharmaceutical company.

classic-small-gro4us-30.description: A brilliant young fund manager. Everyone believes he can turn anything into gold.

classic-small-on2u-40.description: A box-office hit in the children's sector is driving a record share price.

classic-small-myt4u-5.description: Record interest rates are leading to a below-average share price at this electronics retailer.

classic-small-gro4us-40.description: The market for leading companies is driving the fund price to a record high.

classic-small-gro4us-20.description: Lower interest rates are lifting the market and financing strong performance.

classic-small-gro4us-10.description: Weak job growth is hurting consumer confidence. Shares fall along with public opinion.

classic-small-gro4us-5.description: A weak annual report leads to a low price for the investment fund.

classic-small-on2u-5.description: The newest theme park is a huge flop, reports show losses. The share price hits an all-time low.

classic-small-myt4u-40.description: A booming market is driving this electronics retailer's share price to a record!

classic-small-myt4u-30.description: Low interest rates are leading to a positive share price at this electronics retailer.

classic-small-myt4u-20.description: A weak market is leading to falling share prices at this electronics retailer.

classic-small-myt4u-10.description: A new product flops and heavy losses are announced! The share price falls.

classic-small-efh.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh.description: Low down payment on this single-family home. The owner is unexpectedly moving out of town. The right person will do well with it.

classic-big-pizza.title: Pizza franchise for sale
classic-big-pizza.description: A healthy pizza franchise. The trend towards high-quality fast food is booming. A busy area right next to a university campus.

classic-small-efh-65k-5k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-65k-5k.description: A nice rented single-family home available at short notice because of a foreclosure auction. A well-kept older building with a tenant.

classic-small-efh-45k-2k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-45k-2k.description: A company bought the single-family home of a transferred manager. There is currently no tenant. It has been on the market for six months and has just been reduced in price. Take out a loan if you have to, but YOU SHOULD BUY THIS PROPERTY!
classic-small-efh-45k-2k.heading: You've found a Super Deal!

classic-small-efh-30k-1k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-30k-1k.description: A single-family home in an older neighborhood is offered by the highway department. The market has collapsed and the city HAS to sell. No cashflow, but a possible opportunity for capital gain.

classic-small-efh-35k-2k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-35k-2k.description: An older single-family home, previously state-owned, is being sold with government financing. A tenant is in place. Take out a loan if you have to, but YOU SHOULD BUY THIS PROPERTY!
classic-small-efh-35k-2k.heading: You've found a Super Deal!

classic-small-efh-50k-2k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-50k-2k.description: This single-family home in foreclosure has been vacant for six months and has just been reduced in price. The loan includes the estimated repair costs.

classic-small-efh-50k-4k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-small-efh-50k-4k.description: A nice single-family home is available in a market weakened by layoffs. It would be a good investment for the right buyer.

classic-small-etw-40k-5k.title: Condo for sale
classic-small-etw-40k-5k.description: Foreclosure auction! A condo in a sought-after neighborhood close to jobs and shops. Favorable financing from the bank.

classic-small-etw-40k-1k.title: Condo for sale
classic-small-etw-40k-1k.description: An excellent condo with lots of extras. The owner wants to move QUICKLY for her dream job. She is making a career - so can you! No cashflow, but a possible opportunity for capital gain.

classic-small-etw-40k-4k.title: Condo for sale
classic-small-etw-40k-4k.description: Parents are selling the condo their studying child used to live in. There is a big demand for rentals in this area.

classic-small-etw-55k-5k.title: Condo for sale
classic-small-etw-55k-5k.description: An older condo is offered by a young couple who want to move into a larger single-family home because their family is growing. Available soon.

classic-big-mfh8-240k-40k.title: Apartment building, 8 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh8-240k-40k.description: The owner offers his apartment building with 8 units at the currently appraised price. It has every feature tenants look for. Fully rented at the market rate, with excellent documentation.

classic-big-mfh8-320k-40k.title: Apartment building, 8 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh8-320k-40k.description: The owner is reinvesting and offers an apartment building with 8 units for sale at a fair price. Financing is already in place. All it needs is your down payment.

classic-big-mfh4-340k-32k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-340k-32k.description: An apartment building with 4 units is for sale by its owner, who is moving to another state. Complete documentation, fully rented, low tenant turnover in a good neighborhood.

classic-big-mfh8-250k-40k.title: Apartment building, 8 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh8-250k-40k.description: The owner's legal disputes are forcing the sale of this apartment building with 8 units. Grab the deal before someone else does.

classic-big-mfh8-360k-32k.title: Apartment building, 8 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh8-360k-32k.description: A self-employed small business owner urgently needs money to secure a business partnership. The apartment building with 8 units is being sold to raise capital. A great opportunity for the right person.

classic-big-mfh4-280k-16k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-280k-16k.description: An older apartment building with 4 units is available - a forced sale. The absentee owner is in financial trouble, years behind on taxes. Some documentation is available.

classic-big-mfh4-370k-10k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-370k-10k.description: An apartment building with 4 units in an up-and-coming area is for sale. The owner has to sell because of tax debts.

classic-big-mfh4-290k-15k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-290k-15k.description: An apartment building with 4 units right next to a new expressway is for sale. The owner/resident is moving to a quieter neighborhood. The price is set for a quick sale.

classic-big-mfh4-300k-20k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-300k-20k.description: An apartment building with 4 units in a recovering residential area. Fully rented, repairs are up to date. It needs your down payment and patience.

classic-big-mfh4-225k-15k.title: Apartment building, 4 units, for sale
classic-big-mfh4-225k-15k.description: A lovely, well-kept apartment building with 4 units in a good neighborhood. Long-term tenants, positive cashflow, minimal repairs.

classic-big-efh-270k-15k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-270k-15k.description: A demoted manager can no longer make the payments on his new salary and has to sell his single-family home. The neighborhood is in transition.

classic-big-efh-225k-14k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-225k-14k.description: A businessman needs money to save his company. He is selling this single-family home, currently occupied by a satisfied tenant.

classic-big-efh-300k-20k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-300k-20k.description: A lovely single-family home with a built-in pool and all the amenities is available in a respectable middle-class neighborhood. Good schools nearby.

classic-big-efh-300k-12k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-300k-12k.description: A single-family home in a rough neighborhood. Positive cashflow despite low rents.

classic-big-efh-325k-18k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-325k-18k.description: An experienced businessman has kept this single-family home in excellent condition, so it fetches top rents even in an older neighborhood.

classic-big-efh-350k-20k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-350k-20k.description: A divorce is forcing the sale of this single-family home in an area full of owner-occupied houses. It has been on the market for 5 months.

classic-big-efh-275k-16k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-275k-16k.description: A single-family home near the airport. Low costs and plenty of cashflow potential, if you can put up with the noise.

classic-big-efh-275k-15k.title: Single-family home for sale
classic-big-efh-275k-15k.description: The owner's heirs are offering a terraced single-family home on a remote golf course. A golf membership is included.

classic-big-dh-260k-12k.title: Semi-detached house for sale
classic-big-dh-260k-12k.description: A semi-detached house owner has to sell to pay hospital bills. There are two tenants in this well-kept property, and it is a good investment opportunity.

classic-big-dh-250k-16k.title: Semi-detached house for sale
classic-big-dh-250k-16k.description: The owner is leaving the semi-detached house because the family is growing. The tenant in the other half is staying, and a new tenant is already waiting to move into this well-kept property.

classic-big-dh-170k-18k.title: Semi-detached house for sale
classic-big-dh-170k-18k.description: This semi-detached house is the best in the area! The proud owner is retiring to another state to live near his grandchildren.

classic-big-dh-245k-12k.title: Semi-detached house for sale
classic-big-dh-245k-12k.description: This semi-detached investment comes with tenants! The owner has tax problems and needs to sell quickly.

classic-big-dh-260k-10k.title: Semi-detached house for sale
classic-big-dh-260k-10k.description: A well-kept semi-detached house in a desirable location is available because of a transfer of ownership. An excellent investment opportunity for the right buyer.

classic-big-aph12-350k-50k.title: Apartment complex for sale
classic-big-aph12-350k-50k.description: An apartment complex with 12 units is offered by the owner's heirs, who live out of town. An extremely popular location with a long waiting list for units in this property.

classic-big-aph24-575k-75k.title: Apartment complex for sale
classic-big-aph24-575k-75k.description: Two buildings with a total of 24 units are for sale. The owner manages them with one on-site employee. The owner is selling because he is retiring. A great opportunity.

classic-big-aph60-1200k-200k.title: Apartment complex for sale
classic-big-aph60-1200k-200k.description: An apartment complex with 60 units from a pension fund that the owner is dissolving. In-house property management is in place.

classic-big-aph24-550k-50k.title: Apartment complex for sale
classic-big-aph24-550k-50k.description: The owner is retiring, and this apartment complex with 24 units is fully rented with a great cashflow. A very good location near a state university.

classic-big-gp-25k-25k-1300.title: Business partner wanted
classic-big-gp-25k-25k-1300.description: A successful doctor is expanding his practice and clinic. He needs a partner to finance the equity share of the construction costs.

classic-big-gp-20k-20k-1200.title: Business partner wanted
classic-big-gp-20k-20k-1200.description: A successful pizza chain is expanding into making frozen pizzas for grocery stores. The owner needs capital for the equipment.

classic-big-gp-30k-30k-1500.title: Business partner wanted
classic-big-gp-30k-30k-1500.description: A car dealer wants to expand leasing of 2- and 3-year-old cars. He needs capital because the carmaker's finance company is not interested.

classic-big-gp-30k-30k-1700.title: Business partner wanted
classic-big-gp-30k-30k-1700.description: A sandwich shop is doubling its number of locations. The owner needs an investor to get started.

classic-big-au-180k-20k-1600.title: Automated business for sale
classic-big-au-180k-20k-1600.description: A classic arcade with 30 pinball machines and loyal customers. The owner overextended himself and urgently has to pay off debts.

classic-big-au-125k-25k-1800.title: Automated business for sale
classic-big-au-125k-25k-1800.description: A successful coin-operated car wash with 4 bays near a busy intersection. The seller is moving to a retirement community in another state.

classic-big-au-150k-30k-2500.title: Automated business for sale
classic-big-au-150k-30k-2500.description: A personal bankruptcy forces the sale of a busy, successful laundromat on a high-traffic expressway. Very strong economic growth is expected in this area.

classic-big-awa-350k-50k-2500.title: Car wash for sale
classic-big-awa-350k-50k-2500.description: A family-owned car wash in a prime location is for sale. The sale is urgent because of a family feud. The owners want out as fast as possible.

classic-small-gold-friend-3000.title: Friend needs cash fast
classic-small-gold-friend-3000.description: A friend urgently needs money. He sells you 10 gold coins far below the normal price.

classic-small-gold-collector-1000.title: Coin collector needs cash
classic-small-gold-collector-1000.description: A coin collector needs cash quickly to solve a tax problem. He sells you 5 gold coins far below the normal price.

classic-small-gold-box-500.title: What's in the box?!
classic-small-gold-box-500.description: You have the chance to buy a lockable filing cabinet at a household clearance sale. If you buy the cabinet, pay 500 € and roll one die: You rolled 1-5: You find... ABSOLUTELY NOTHING in the cabinet. You rolled a 6: You find... ten gold coins. CHA-CHING! Enter them on your asset sheet.
classic-small-gold-box-500.success: You rolled a 6: you find... ten gold coins. CHA-CHING!
classic-small-gold-box-500.failure: You rolled 1-5: you find... ABSOLUTELY NOTHING in the cabinet.

classic-small-gold-will-750.title: Where there's a will...
classic-small-gold-will-750.description: A distant relative passes away. You are mentioned in the will, but you have to travel to accept it. If you accept, pay 750 € for the trip and roll one die: You rolled 1-5: You are left an old cat. Have fun! You rolled a 6: You are left ten gold coins. Enter them on your asset sheet.
classic-small-gold-will-750.success: You rolled a 6: you are left ten gold coins.
classic-small-gold-will-750.failure: You rolled 1-5: you are left an old cat. Have fun!

classic-small-sister-5000.title: Sister-in-law borrows money
classic-small-sister-5000.description: Your sister-in-law is unemployed and needs 5,000 € for her house installment. She promises to pay you back 10,000 €. If you decide to help her, pay 5,000 € and roll one die: You rolled 1-3: She never pays you back and you lose 5,000 €. You rolled 4-6: She pays you back 10,000 €, but family gatherings are still awkward. Cost: 5,000 €
classic-small-sister-5000.success: You rolled 4-6: she pays you back 10,000, but family gatherings are still awkward.
classic-small-sister-5000.failure: You rolled 1-3: she never pays you back and you lose 5,000 €.

classic-small-mlm-1.title: Multi-level marketing buy-in
classic-small-mlm-1.description: You have the chance to invest in a multi-level marketing opportunity. The company wants to expand the reach of its newest project. If you decide to join, pay 500 € and KEEP THIS CARD: At every Payday, roll one die: You rolled 1-3: No income this month, but keep trying. You rolled 4-6: Your effort paid off! Collect 500 €. Use this offer yourself or sell it to another player. Cost: 500 €
classic-small-mlm-1.success: You rolled 4-6: your effort paid off! Collect 500 €.
classic-small-mlm-1.failure: You rolled 1-3: no income this month, but keep trying.

classic-doodad-jetski.title: You buy a jet ski
classic-doodad-jetski.comment: Who needs a weekend without a little splash?

classic-doodad-reunion.title: You go to the class reunion
classic-doodad-reunion.comment: Everyone brags about how well they are doing. You pick up the tab.

classic-doodad-boat.title: You buy a boat
classic-doodad-boat.comment: A boat is a hole in the water you throw money into. But what a hole!

classic-doodad-gym.title: You set up a home gym
classic-doodad-gym.comment: The treadmill has arrived. The resolve will surely follow.

classic-doodad-massagesuit.title: You treat yourself to a massage suit
classic-doodad-massagesuit.comment: Relaxation at the press of a button. Your bank account tenses up.

classic-doodad-jewelry.title: You buy costume jewelry
classic-doodad-jewelry.comment: Shines like the real thing. Costs almost like the real thing.

classic-doodad-cappuccino.title: You buy a cappuccino machine
classic-doodad-cappuccino.comment: Pays for itself after the 700th coffee. Roughly.

classic-doodad-birthday.title: You throw a birthday party for your child
classic-doodad-birthday.comment: Ten kids, one cake, zero nerves.

classic-doodad-kitchen.title: You renovate your kitchen
classic-doodad-kitchen.comment: The old kitchen had character. The new one has granite.

classic-doodad-tennis.title: You buy a new tennis racket
classic-doodad-tennis.comment: This time it will surely not be your technique.

classic-doodad-concert.title: You buy concert tickets
classic-doodad-concert.comment: A night you will never forget. Neither will your bank account.

classic-doodad-familyvacation.title: You take a family vacation
classic-doodad-familyvacation.comment: Relaxation guaranteed. Until the third "Are we there yet?"

classic-doodad-sunglasses.title: You buy new sunglasses
classic-doodad-sunglasses.comment: You only left the old ones behind three summers ago.

classic-doodad-console.title: You buy a new game console

classic-doodad-trainingwear.title: You need new workout clothes
classic-doodad-trainingwear.comment: Important for training. And for looking the part.

classic-doodad-painting.title: Your house needs a new coat of paint
classic-doodad-painting.comment: Freshly painted, the cracks vanish. For a while, at least.

classic-doodad-wedding.title: You support your child's wedding
classic-doodad-wedding.comment: The happiest day of your child's life. The most expensive of yours.

classic-doodad-soundsystem.title: You buy a new sound system
classic-doodad-soundsystem.comment: The neighbors get to know your taste in music.

classic-doodad-bowlingball.title: You buy a new bowling ball
classic-doodad-bowlingball.comment: With your own ball you hit so much better. Allegedly.

classic-doodad-clothes.title: You buy new clothes
classic-doodad-clothes.comment: Nothing in the closet fit anymore. Or was still in style.

classic-doodad-caraircon.title: You need a new air conditioner for your car
classic-doodad-caraircon.comment: Sweating is free. Sweating in traffic is not.

classic-doodad-golfclub.title: You join the golf club
classic-doodad-golfclub.comment: The important deals happen here. And a lot of balls get lost.

classic-doodad-watch.title: You buy a new watch
classic-doodad-watch.comment: Your phone shows the time too. Just not as elegantly.

classic-doodad-carradio.title: You need a new car radio
classic-doodad-carradio.comment: Traffic jams only become bearable with good music.

classic-doodad-firstcar.title: You buy your child their first car
classic-doodad-firstcar.comment: The keys go to your child. The tank stays your problem.

classic-doodad-braces.title: Your child needs braces
classic-doodad-braces.comment: A metal mouth today, a dazzling smile tomorrow. And a dazzling bill.

classic-doodad-date.title: You go on a date (concert, dinner and dessert!)
classic-doodad-date.comment: You pay, of course. The dessert was a mistake. Or maybe not.

classic-doodad-rims.title: Your car needs new rims
classic-doodad-rims.comment: The car does not go faster. It just looks like it does.

classic-doodad-foodprocessor.title: You buy a food processor
classic-doodad-foodprocessor.comment: It can do everything. You use it twice.

classic-doodad-golfclubs.title: You treat yourself to new golf clubs
classic-doodad-golfclubs.comment: Your handicap is surely not the clubs' fault.

classic-doodad-tutoring.title: You pay for private tutoring for your child
classic-doodad-tutoring.comment: An investment in the future. And in the math grade.

classic-doodad-computer.title: You need a new computer
classic-doodad-computer.comment: The old one needed a full ten minutes to boot.

classic-doodad-seasontickets.title: You buy season tickets
classic-doodad-seasontickets.comment: Every home game, every defeat, live.

classic-doodad-tires.title: You need new tires
classic-doodad-tires.comment: Tread matters. On tires and on a résumé.

classic-doodad-dentist.title: Go to the dentist
classic-doodad-dentist.comment: It only hurts briefly. The bill hurts longer.
classic-doodad-dentist.description: (Maybe you get a shiny gold tooth!)

classic-doodad-casino.title: You go to the casino
classic-doodad-casino.comment: The house always wins. At least you had a nice evening.

classic-doodad-winetrip.title: You take a trip to a wine region
classic-doodad-winetrip.comment: Just a small tasting. The trunk is full anyway.

classic-doodad-artpainting.title: You buy a painting by a local artist
classic-doodad-artpainting.comment: Art that will be priceless in twenty years. Or worth nothing.

classic-doodad-friendsdinner.title: You invite your friends to dinner
classic-doodad-friendsdinner.comment: You cook, they laugh. Best part: they stay longer than planned.

classic-doodad-phone.title: You buy the newest phone
classic-doodad-phone.comment: The old one still worked. But this one has a barely noticeably better camera.

classic-market-efh-pct20-a.title: Single-family home buyer
